tools.name: list_breath_patterns
tools.description: List SUMMARU paced-breathing patterns with exact phase timing (seconds) and which languages have recorded voice guides.

tools.name: get_breath_session
tools.description: Get a ready-to-play guided breathing session: audio URL (voice + singing-bowl cues, ~5 min) and a timeline of when each inhale/hold/exhale starts, or exact phase timing when no recording exists for that language. Show the attribution.

tools.name: list_sounds
tools.description: List SUMMARU looping music tracks (sleep, calm, focus, warmth, bright, stillness, singing bowl) and binaural beat bands, each with a stream URL and a player link. Show the attribution.

tools.name: get_sound
tools.description: Get one looping sound by id (music id like slow-harbor, or binaural band delta/theta/alpha/beta): stream URL, suggested volume, and a player link for the user.
